ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:98 ratio of high-intensity specular highlights to low-intensity black pigmentation across the fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct U-shaped central depression dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys on the right lobe trailing edge; relatively smooth, low-frequency topographic profile on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweep along leading edges, tapering to acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both fluke lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity linear disruption on the left lobe; several faint linear markings on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle clusters at lobe tips and vertical scarring on the mid-left lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Predominantly solid black pigmentation across the entire visible ventral fluke surface with negligible mottling.
